language.label: Language
language.description: Language of the interface, of Nicx's answers and of the voice.

page.title: Settings
page.description: App preferences: appearance, models, voice, memory and your data.

connection.invalidAddress: That is not an address (it must start with http://). Leave it blank to use the default.
connection.addressHint: Leave it blank. Only change it if the Nicx server runs on another port or machine.
connection.apiKeyDescription: Only needed if the server was started with an API key

inference.sourceDescription: Where the app runs models. Applies after a restart.
inference.modelDescription: ID of the model served by your server
inference.apiKeyDescription: Only if your server asks for one
inference.apiKeyPlaceholder: leave blank if you have none
inference.saved: Saved. Restart the app to apply.

models.localDescription: Models that run on this computer
models.pullAfter: in your terminal to download more models

apiKeys.saveFailed: Could not save the API key
apiKeys.removeFailed: Could not remove the API key

tools.webSearchDescription: Tavily key for the web search tool

memory.useContextDescription: Automatically adds relevant memories to conversations

voice.inputDescription: Use the microphone for dictation and voice conversation (local recognition)
voice.outputDescription: Show the button to listen to Nicx's answers
voice.autoplayDescription: Read each answer aloud as soon as it ends
voice.ttsDescription: Engine and voice used for spoken answers
voice.setupHint: Set up speech recognition to use voice input.

wake.enableDescription: Say “Nicx, ligar” (or “Ei Nicx”) and the mascot shows up ready for a voice conversation. The microphone stays open only on this computer: nothing is recorded or sent.
wake.noWindow: No floating window on this computer: the interface opens in the browser.
wake.howToStop: Say “tchau” or “desligar” to make the mascot leave; it also goes away after 1 minute of silence.
wake.autostartDescription: Starts listening when you sign in to Windows (only if the option above is on)

shortcut.title: Keyboard shortcut
shortcut.enableDescription: Press the combination in any window and Nicx shows up. Windows only; off until you turn it on.
shortcut.keysDescription: Click and press the keys together (e.g. Ctrl + Alt + N). Esc cancels.
shortcut.statusDescription: If the window is already open, the shortcut just brings it to the front.
shortcut.inUseHint: Another program already uses this combination: record a different one.

errors.needModifier: Use Ctrl, Alt or Win together with the key.
errors.unsupportedKey: This key cannot be used in the shortcut.
errors.reserved: This combination belongs to the system or is widely used; choose another.

shortcut.restartServer: Restart the Nicx server to use the shortcut

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.enableDescription: Press the shortcut, speak, and the text is typed where the cursor is. Everything stays on your PC; no audio is kept. Windows only; off until you turn it on.
dictation.keysDescription: Click and press the keys together (e.g. Ctrl + Alt + D). It must differ from the Nicx shortcut.

modeDescriptions.alternar: Press to start and again to stop; stops by itself after 1.5 s of silence (60 s at most).
modeDescriptions.segurar: Records while the key is held down (60 s at most).

dictation.soundDescription: A short beep when listening starts and ends
dictation.statusDescription: The text goes into the window that had focus when you pressed {{keys}}.
dictation.inUseHint: Another app already uses this combination: record a different one.
dictation.commandsHint: Voice commands: "new line", "new paragraph", "full stop" and "comma" (also in Portuguese).
dictation.restartServer: Restart the Nicx server to use dictation

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.defaultDescription: Where "send it to my calendar" goes. You can also say the name: "send it to Google Calendar", "send it to Outlook".

google.unknown: Google Calendar: connected (I try to create directly).
google.readOnly: Google Calendar: read-only; reconnect to create directly.

outlook.none: Outlook: no account with calendar permission.
outlook.unknown: Outlook: connected (I try to create directly).
outlook.readOnly: Outlook: no calendar permission; reconnect to create directly.

calendar.linkHint: Without a connected account, Nicx opens the event already filled in your browser: just click Save.
calendar.saveFailed: Could not save the default calendar
calendar.restartServer: Restart the Nicx server to choose the calendar

context.title: Screen context
context.enabledLabel: Read what I copied and the open window
context.enabledDescription: For requests like "summarize what I copied", "explain this here", "what is this error?" and "where am I?". The text only goes to the local model and never into memory.
context.copyDescription: If the app doesn't expose the selected text, Nicx presses Ctrl+C in that window (only while it's in front) and then restores what you had copied.
context.limitDescription: Longer texts are cut in the middle; the model's limit also applies.
context.privacyHint: Password and banking windows are never read. Nothing leaves your PC.
context.windowsOnly: For now, the clipboard and the open window can only be read on Windows.
context.saveFailed: Could not save the screen context settings
context.restartServer: Restart the Nicx server to use screen context

dailySummary.title: Daily summary
dailySummary.enabledDescription: At the chosen time, with Nicx open, shows a notification and reads the summary aloud: appointments, reminders, notes, organized folders and projects. Once a day.
dailySummary.timeDescription: If Nicx only opens after this time, the summary comes as soon as it starts (same day).
dailySummary.daysDescription: Which days of the week the summary comes.
dailySummary.speakDescription: Uses the local voice, if installed.
dailySummary.notifyDescription: System notification with the summary text.
dailySummary.refining: The model is rewriting… (may take a minute)
dailySummary.refineHint: Asks the local model to rewrite the text. It's slower.
dailySummary.hint: You can also ask in the chat or by voice: "daily summary", "how was my day?", "what's still pending today?". Everything stays on your PC.
dailySummary.restartServer: Restart the Nicx server to use the daily summary
